title: North Dakota Century Code Chapter 54-52.4 - State Employee Leave Policies
verified_how: fetched the register's Title 54 chapter index (https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t54.html): title 'Title 54 - State Government', chapter row '54-52.4' with name 'State Employee Leave Policies', no '[Repealed]' marker; then fetched https://ndlegis.gov/cencode/t54c52-4.html, which lists sections from 54-52.4-01. Currency: 07/01/25 update, 69th Legislative Assembly.
notes: IMPORTANT SCOPE LIMIT: this is the only leave-entitlement statute in the Century Code and it binds state agencies as employers, not private employers. North Dakota has no general private-sector annual-leave, sick-leave or holiday-pay statute; private-sector family and medical leave is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 28), and accrued vacation pay on separation is dealt with through the wage-collection chapter (ch. 34-14) rather than by an entitlement statute. A human should decide whether a state-employee-only statute is the right fit for this topic.
